subject: Technical scope re-sequencing & evidence handback for SOW amendment
messages:
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@helix.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Seth Moreno <seth@cloudops.io>
Cc: LegalOps Team <legal@helix.ai>
Date: 2025-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: reorder milestones + 2-node private cluster add-on + evidence request

Markus / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. After internal review we've had two requests from our Compliance and Cloud teams that will require an update to the SOW:

- Re-sequence milestones so the data migration & validation step (previously milestone 3) runs before full production cutover (previously milestone 2). This is to allow a staged acceptance window for our auditors.
- Add a private cluster supplement: +2 reserved nodes (same spec as production nodes) for a dedicated pilot environment for 8 weeks.
- Provide evidence package: access to audit logs for the pilot period, a short runbook for key rotation, and a snapshot of your SOC2 artifact list.

We understand this will change the implementation schedule and fees. Can you confirm what the commercial impact would be (one-time implementation and monthly reserved fee) and whether Redwood can provide the requested evidence artifacts (or a path to produce them)? I've attached the current SOW draft for context.

Attachments: helix_sow_v2.docx (attached)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Paul
Paul Reynolds
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Helix.ai
paul.reynolds@helix.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Seth Moreno <seth@cloudops.io>
Date: 2025-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reorder milestones + 2-node private cluster add-on + evidence request

Team — looping you in for redlines and impact. Quick summary of asks from Helix: reorder acceptance milestones, add 2 reserved private nodes for 8 weeks, and provide an evidence bundle for compliance.

Immediate asks:
- Legal (Naomi): please draft redlines to the MSA / SOW that cover scope sequencing, acceptance criteria tied to staged migration, and a short clause on audit-access (what we can reasonably provide and how we sanitize logs). Also check termination/rollback language if the pilot exceeds budget.
- Commercial/Procurement (Connor): estimate one-time implementation hours and monthly reserved fee for +2 nodes. Provide a short pricing note and whether a pro-rated charge for an 8-week pilot is acceptable.
- Ops (Laura): produce an implementation checklist with lead times for provisioning private nodes, an ops runbook outline for rotation and logging, and an ETA for a pilot start (we need X weeks to provision in us-west).

Please work in parallel — Helix wants an answer this week. I flagged DocuSign will be required once we get to final.

Quoted: 
> On 2025-05-11 09:12, Paul Reynolds wrote:
> Markus / team,
> > After internal review we've had two requests from our Compliance and Cloud teams that will require an update to the SOW: ...
> > Attachments: helix_sow_v2.docx

Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-12T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal: reorder milestones + 2-node private cluster add-on + evidence request

Markus — thanks for the ping. I reviewed Helix's ask and prepared a redline package. Summary below; full redlines attached (helix_sow_v3_redlines.pdf).

Legal summary (high level):
1) Definitions: add a definition for "Pilot Private Cluster" and clarify ownership of logs and retention periods (we propose 90 days retention for pilot logs unless Customer requests otherwise in writing).
2) Acceptance sequencing: update SOW schedule to make "Migration Validation" a precondition for Production Cutover. Add a 10-business-day staged acceptance window with explicit pass/fail criteria (test-set pass rate, smoke test checklist).
3) Fees and pro-rating: propose a one-time implementation fee for provisioning & migration (see redline §4.2) and a prorated monthly reserved fee for the 8-week pilot (50% of full monthly rate given the timebox).
4) Audit evidence & access: we will provide sanitized audit log extracts and a snapshot of SOC2 attestations. Include a clause restricting log access to named contacts and requiring a written NDA for any deeper artifact review.
5) Rollback / cancellation: add a clause permitting either party to pause the cutover within the staged acceptance window with a defined remediation plan and cost-sharing language.

Action items for Helix sign-off: legal to confirm the 90-day retention and whether they require raw logs or extracts (we should avoid granting raw persistent access). Procurement to agree the proposed prorate calculation. Ops to confirm provisioning lead times so we can commit to a pilot start date.

Attachments: helix_sow_v3_redlines.pdf (redline PDF)

Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
aomi.feldman@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
On 2025-05-11 10:03, markus_klein wrote:
> Team — looping you in for redlines and impact...

From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@helix.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Seth Moreno <seth@cloudops.io>, LegalOps Team <legal@helix.ai>
Date: 2025-05-13T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: reorder milestones + 2-node private cluster add-on + evidence request

Markus / Naomi / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the redlines. We're broadly aligned on the updates and the 90-day retention is acceptable. A couple of clarifications before we finalize:

- Pro-rate calculation: the 50% pilot rate for 8 weeks looks reasonable; please confirm the one-time implementation cap (Naomi's redline referenced an estimate).
- Signers: can you include the following on the DocuSign envelope: Paul Reynolds (Helix, PO), Elena Ortiz (Helix Legal) and Markus Klein (Redwood signatory).
- Ops: Seth (cc'd) will coordinate the provisioning window; he asked for the ops checklist and an ETA — if we can start provisioning the week of 6/2 that would meet Helix's internal timeline.

I've attached the Helix ops checklist we use for pilots so you can align your runbook: ops-implementation-checklist.xlsx

DocuSign (provisional): https://app.docusign.com/Helix/Envelope/ABC123DEF

If we get these two clarifications today, Helix can route for signature tomorrow and target a provisioning kickoff 6/2.

Paul
Paul Reynolds
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Helix.ai
paul.reynolds@helix.ai
